plan.architecture: 48 hidden, 3 layers, reference GRU, 19 matched training-standardised anchor-gap context dimensions in all five networks; matching stage budgets recorded in steps_per_stage; batch128; LR.001; order penalty0; partial reconstruction power.5.
plan.decoder: One bounded common best-bid return plus 19 positive relative gaps from the starting book. Residual log-gap ranges are 1.1 times maximum absolute training-window log-gap change, floored at .1. Convert ordered prices to required scaled log-return targets. Volume sigmoid unchanged. No sorting/clipping/repair.
plan.pairing: Same trainable parameter dimensions, initialization seed, minibatch and noise streams. Decoder adds buffers only. Both fits start fresh; no reconstruction warm start.

plan.quality_criteria: Relative screen is exploratory, not assignment/model success. Also show absolute KL targets .1, depth SSIM .6, structural validity and three cases. One training seed cannot establish retraining reliability.
plan.followup: Wait for both fits and selected/fixed-final audits. If useful, prioritise paired independent-seed replication within measured remaining runtime. conclusion: All three full fits completed, but neither ladder setting passed the unchanged full quality screen. The decoder produced 0% invalid snapshots; this establishes ordering in the evaluated samples, not simulator realism. At fixed final update 5,000, reducing LR from 0.001 to 0.0003 improved spread KL 0.179 to 0.112, ACF error 0.432 to 0.380 and depth SSIM 0.099 to 0.123, while return KL worsened 0.554 to 0.827 and price-correlation error worsened 0.431 to 0.614. The selected lower-LR checkpoint at 4,000 reached SSIM 0.171 and return KL 0.388, then deteriorated. Both selected ladder settings retained noise variation in the three fixed-anchor cases; both final settings failed a noise floor. Lower LR therefore did not establish a stable overall improvement. Neither ladder setting met both KL targets and the SSIM target.
next_step: Use the saved checkpoints to separate errors in the common price movement, relative gaps and volume changes before another fit. Prioritise the weak return dynamics and cross-price dependence, and inspect the continuous volume changes against the sparse real updates. Predeclare one targeted experiment from that diagnosis and retain the same quality and fixed-anchor diversity gates. A setting that passes would then need paired independent training-seed repeats before a reliability claim. No further training was launched in this study; the final test remains unscored.
limitations: One training seed per setting; three generation seeds measure sampling variation only. No final-test scoring.
Ordering is imposed by architecture; zero invalidity does not establish realistic dynamics. Existing validity metrics do not check tick alignment or integer share sizes.

The decoder changes feature support as well as ordering: bid returns and volumes remain training-range bounded, other price returns may exceed those ranges, and log-gap changes remain bounded around each starting book.
Checkpoint selection ranks invalidity first; with zero invalidity in the ladder arm, it becomes mainly distribution-driven. Fixed-final comparisons are therefore reported separately.
Fixed-anchor noise diagnostics are necessary because variation across different starting books can conceal weak stochastic response. Distinct sequences alone do not rule out collapse.
This is a labelled conditional architecture/reconstruction-loss extension, separate from the authors reference and earlier unconditioned studies. No sorting or output repair.

Test lower global LR.0003 against existing ladder LR.001 as one controlled optimization-sensitivity adjustment; architecture,seed,budgets,losses and data remain fixed. This is a hypothesis, not evidence that lower LR will solve the failures.

diagnosis.primary_comparison: Fixed-final 5,000 updates isolates learning rate. Selected checkpoints are supplementary and occur at different updates.
diagnosis.screen_scope: All original pilot gates compare against the ordinary decoder. For the lower-LR arm that comparison changes decoder and LR; use learning_rate_changes to isolate LR.
diagnosis.reconstruction: Final validation price/volume MSE divided by variance is 0.675/0.218 at LR 0.0003 versus 0.599/0.00781 at LR 0.001. Lower LR slows recovery; recovery quality alone does not predict generation quality.
diagnosis.shifted_context: With decoder anchors fixed, shifting network context improved lower-LR marginal spread KL to about 0.0765 selected and 0.0785 final, but reduced depth SSIM. Dependence on context is present; correctly paired context does not consistently improve marginal price fidelity. This is a diagnostic control, not a candidate or evidence that context is useless.
diagnosis.case_observation: All ladder cases remain ordered. Generated volumes change at every successive entry in the three cases, unlike the sparse observed updates; continuous changes and sub-cent gaps limit microstructure realism.
diagnosis.retraining_uncertainty: One training seed per setting. Generation seeds 42, 43 and 44 measure sampling variation only; no retraining SD can be estimated.
